purpose: Replace only V48's unconstrained Gaussian asymptote with a proper train-only bounded logit transform likelihood, while retaining the occupied five-component latent Gaussian structure and holding all information, data, architecture, optimization, donor ranks, controls, and development gates fixed.

parent_evidence.required_family: proper train-only bounded-support monotone conditional transform likelihood

immutable_inputs.rule: inherit every V48 train input, split, cached array, channel, U-Net parameter, optimizer, schedule, augmentation, donor identity, donor isometry, member pairing, development threshold, control, and firewall except the explicitly replaced target-space Gaussian likelihood, its CDF/inverse transform, and its transformed identifiable output biases

channels: V41 full extreme-structure block probability lifted from 16^3 to 64^3
V41 object log10 mean delta squared prediction broadcast over 64^3
conditioning.standardization: exact immutable V45 train-only scalar target mean and standard deviation

bounded_target_transform.support_source: exact V50 train-only support selection artifact frozen before model implementation
bounded_target_transform.boundary_handling: no clipping or epsilon adjustment of observed targets; any target outside or on the open support is a hard error
bounded_target_transform.physical_property: for every finite query backbone, generated residual z is strictly bounded and therefore every physical density moment is finite

latent_likelihood.distribution: five-component continuous Gaussian mixture independently parameterized in latent x at every native voxel
latent_likelihood.objective: equal-source mean exact transformed Gaussian-mixture negative log likelihood including the immutable log-Jacobian

network.output_weight_initialization: exactly zero for all 15 one-by-one convolution output rows
network.bias_construction: map each V48 standardized location through the frozen logit transform and multiply each V48 component scale by the exact local derivative dx/dz at that location before the unchanged softplus(raw)+0.01 parameterization
network.trainability: all output weights and all 15 biases remain trainable; transformed locations identify components at initialization and no predicted parameter is capped

training.mixed_precision: CUDA autocast plus GradScaler; transformed Gaussian-mixture log probabilities and Jacobian remain float32
training.augmentation: uniform one of the same 48 signed cube isometries applied jointly to all conditioning channels and target
training.validation: fixed diagnostic transformed NLL at steps 4000, 8000, and 12000; never used for stopping, selection, support, or hyperparameter changes

sampling.candidate: same-voxel monotone bounded-mixture CDF inversion of the unchanged paired V31 donor conditional-rank field
sampling.inverse: unchanged 28-step latent Gaussian-mixture inverse at rank epsilon 1e-7 followed by the exact frozen sigmoid support transform
sampling.post_sample: undo the immutable V45 standardization and apply one exact residual DC projection before adding the unchanged query backbone

matched_arms.bounded_query_local_mixture_copula: actual query-local latent parameters and unchanged paired donor ranks; the only selectable arm
matched_arms.rolled_parameter_control: periodically roll all 15 latent parameter fields by (16,8,4) native voxels while keeping query backbone and donor rank fixed
matched_arms.structure_risk_ablation: set the standardized V41 block-risk input channel to zero while retaining every other input and donor rank
matched_arms.common: identical query, donor, isometry, V31 rank field, backbone, fitted model, sampling arithmetic, frozen support, and exact DC rule except for the named control change

development_evaluation.primary_pass: bounded_query_local_mixture_copula passes field, Q3, and Q4 independently in every domain

fixed_branches.condition: Q3 and Q4 pass every domain but any field check fails
high-k power and residual RMS pass every domain but Q3 or Q4 fails anywhere
rolled parameter control equals or improves candidate Q3 and Q4 jointly in every domain

hard_preflight: full pytest and clean committed worktree
exact V49 record, V50 support record and artifact, V48 program, and immutable conditioning-cache hashes and decision digests
prove all source-balanced real train targets lie strictly inside the frozen open support with no clipping
prove forward and inverse support transforms and transformed likelihood Jacobian are finite and mutually consistent

prove the initial output biases equal the frozen values, all five latent locations are distinct, and 128-point Gauss-Hermite quadrature reproduces the frozen initial standardized mean and variance within 1e-6
prove same-role component gradients are nonidentical and at least two component locations and scales diverge after two deterministic optimizer steps
prove all physical residual moments are finite from the bounded support without parameter or sample caps
network shape, parameter count, finite likelihood, nonzero finite gradients, and CDF inverse consistency
one real source-balanced GPU step with peak allocated memory below 24 GiB
one real paired-donor bounded sample is finite, remains strictly inside support before DC projection, has no rank permutation, and residual DC below 1e-7 after projection
Astrid and historical EAGLE remain unopened
